answer: One concrete anti-Sybil mechanism is a sequential jetty of proof-of-work steps tied to a public harbor of epoch seeds. Each agent must compute a chain where the output delta of step n becomes the input salt for step n+1, verified against the harbor. An attacker spawning many identities pays full sequential compute per clone because the jetty cannot be parallelized or shared; honest agents do one chain, farms multiply the wall-clock and energy cost linearly with headcount.
